[&amp;&gt;p]:m-0 [&amp;&gt;p+p]:mt-1.5 [&amp;_code]:rounded [&amp;_code]:bg-white/5 [&amp;_code]:px-1.5 [&amp;_code]:py-0.5 [&amp;_code]:text-[13px] [&amp;_code]:text-foreground [&amp;_strong]:font-medium [&amp;_strong]:text-foreground [&amp;_a]:text-foreground [&amp;_a]:underline [&amp;_a]:decoration-white/30 [&amp;_a]:underline-offset-4 hover:[&amp;_a]:decoration-white/60">在对话框输入一句简单指令，比如让 Agent <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">列出当前目录的文件</strong>，确认响应正常。</div></li></ol>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果还没有配置模型，点击左下角 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">连接使用</strong> 进入登录页面，引导你 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">连接 Z.ai</strong>、<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">连接 BigModel</strong> 或 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">使用 API Key</strong> 完成接入，详见下一节 连接模型。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="proxy">网络代理<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果你的网络需要走代理才能访问模型服务，在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 → 常规</strong> 里可以配置。这里有三个字段，填完点保存，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">需要重启应用才生效</strong>。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260730-core-features/settings/proxy-configuration.webp" alt="设置 → 常规 的网络代理：HTTP 代理、代理例外与自定义证书三个字段（图中为演示值）" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">HTTP 代理</strong>：填入代理地址，例如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">http://127.0.0.1:7890</code>。</p>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">留空不等于跟随系统。</strong> 这个字段为空时 ZCode 直连，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">不会读取 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">HTTP_PROXY</code> 等系统环境变量</strong>。这一点和很多命令行工具的默认行为相反，如果你发现终端里能联网而 ZCode 不行，多半就是这个原因。</p>
</blockquote>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">配置后，模型请求、MCP 服务、Agent 执行的命令工具以及应用界面的网络请求都会走这个代理。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">代理例外</strong>：不想走代理的地址，用英文逗号分隔，例如：</p>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-text">localhost,127.0.0.1,::1,.example.com,*.corp.com
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">主机名、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.example.com</code> 这样的域名后缀、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">*.corp.com</code> 通配写法都支持，需要时还能带上端口。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">自定义证书</strong>：填 PEM 格式根证书的本地文件路径。企业内网如果用了会解密 HTTPS 的安全网关，它签发的证书默认不被信任，把对应的根证书填在这里即可。注意这<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">不是</strong>跳过证书校验——ZCode 只放行证书链里确实包含这张根证书的连接，其余照常校验。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="windows-settings">Windows 专属设置<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">选择命令行环境。</strong> 在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 → 常规 → 终端</strong> 里可以指定 Agent 执行命令时用哪个 shell，可选 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">自动选择</strong>、<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">CMD</strong> 和 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Git Bash</strong>（检测到已安装时才出现）。默认是自动，优先用 Git Bash，找不到就回退到 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">cmd.exe</code>。改动<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">只对新建会话生效</strong>。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">关闭窗口时最小化到托盘。</strong> 从 v3.4.0 起这是默认行为：点窗口的关闭按钮不会退出应用，而是收进系统托盘继续运行，定时任务和闲时任务也因此能在后台照常推进。托盘图标右键有新建任务、打开工作区、检查更新、退出等菜单项，左键点击可以把窗口叫回来。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">想让关闭按钮直接退出，在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 → 常规 → 通知</strong> 里关掉「关闭窗口时隐藏到托盘」即可。这个开关只有 Windows 有。</p>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">从旧版本升级上来的用户请留意：这次默认值调整会把该开关 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">重置为开启一次</strong>，即使你之前手动关过。再关一次之后就会一直保持你的选择。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
